zh: 峰会提词器与演示联动新增实时双语展示字幕（支持跟随讲稿与配音或现场麦克风翻译，覆盖中文、英文与阿拉伯语）及图标化控制栏。
同步更新峰会提词器中/英/阿多语种与慢速朗读音频清单并对接独立媒体仓库（we-ai-narration-20261122-1），保障材料正常按需拉取与播放音频。
修复对话顶栏「···」更多操作菜单：窗口或侧栏收窄后再拉宽时，按钮现在会自动恢复显示；收起时机改为按标题保底宽度判断，管理员的「终端」入口也会出现在「···」菜单中。
en: Summit teleprompter and presentation sync now support live bilingual on-screen captions (following script/narration or live microphone translation across Chinese, English, and Arabic) with an iconified control bar.
Updated the Chinese, English, and Arabic teleprompter narration and slow-pace audio manifest backed by the standalone media repository (we-ai-narration-20261122-1) for reliable audio playback.

Fixed the chat header "···" more-actions menu: buttons now come back automatically when the window or sidebar is widened again, collapsing uses a minimum title width, and the Terminal entry for admins appears in the menu.
